name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A compound avatar component with image, text, placeholder, and indicator positioning. Uses namespace exports: Avatar.Root, Avatar.Image, Avatar.Indicator. Pair with status-indicator for status dots, verified badges, and more.

docs.lead: A compound avatar component with image, text, placeholder, and indicator positioning. Pair with StatusIndicator for status dots, verified badges, and more.
docs.usage:
import * as Avatar from "@/components/ui/avatar"
import * as StatusIndicator from "@/components/ui/status-indicator"

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  <Avatar.Indicator>
    <StatusIndicator.Root status="online" />
  </Avatar.Indicator>
</Avatar.Root>

examples.title: Color
examples.description: Avatar backgrounds in different colors: gray (default), yellow, blue, sky, purple, red, and primary.

examples.title: Text
examples.description: Pass text children (e.g. initials) instead of an image.

examples.title: Placeholder
examples.description: When no children are provided, a placeholder icon is shown. Use placeholderType to switch between user and company icons.

examples.title: Status
examples.description: Show user status (online, offline, busy, away) using Avatar.Indicator and StatusIndicator.
examples.code:
import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  <Avatar.Indicator>
    <StatusIndicator.Root status="online" />
  </Avatar.Indicator>
</Avatar.Root>

examples.title: Notification
examples.description: Show a notification dot using Avatar.Indicator with position='top' and StatusIndicator.
examples.code:
import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  <Avatar.Indicator position="top">
    <StatusIndicator.Root status="notification" />
  </Avatar.Indicator>
</Avatar.Root>

examples.title: Brand Logo
examples.description: Show a brand logo using Avatar.Indicator and StatusIndicator company variant with children.
examples.code: import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

examples.title: Verified Badge
examples.description: Show a verified badge using Avatar.Indicator and StatusIndicator verified variant.
examples.code:
import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  <Avatar.Indicator position="top">
    <StatusIndicator.Root status="verified" />
  </Avatar.Indicator>
</Avatar.Root>

examples.title: Top Indicators
examples.description: All top-position status indicators: verified, pin, favorite, add, remove, and notification.
examples.code:
import * as StatusIndicator from '@/components/ui/status-indicator'

<Avatar.Root>
  <Avatar.Image src="/path/to/image.png" />
  <Avatar.Indicator position="top">
    <StatusIndicator.Root status="pin" />
  </Avatar.Indicator>
</Avatar.Root>

examples.title: Custom Placeholder
examples.description: Pass a custom ReactNode via the placeholder prop to replace the default icon while keeping the avatar container styling.
examples.code:
<Avatar.Root
  placeholder={<RiBuildingLine className="w-10 h-10" />}
  color="primary"
/>
<Avatar.Root
  placeholder={<RiBuildingLine className="w-8 h-8" />}
  color="primary"
  size="64"
/>

examples.title: Square Rounded
examples.description: Override the default circular shape by passing a rounded className to Avatar.Root. The image inherits the rounding automatically. Use rounded-lg for larger sizes and rounded-md for smaller ones.

examples.title: As Link
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render the avatar as a link or other element.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the avatar in pixels

props.name: placeholderType
props.description: The placeholder icon type when no children are provided

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Custom placeholder content rendered when no children are provided. Overrides placeholderType.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot
